findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 22 requests to 5 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 3.6 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 437 kB (12%) came from third-party domains, 47 kB of it from services classified as tracking (6 requests).

2 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: dotmetrics.net (Ipsos (Dotmetrics), audience measurement), scorecardresearch.com (Comscore, audience measurement).
3 cookies were set by third-party domains (16 cookies in total).
